snippet.title: Black 9 [XBOX Intro & GamePlay 01 - CANCELLED!]
snippet.description:
http://www.unseen64.net

"June 28, 2004 - On Friday we reported on heavy rumors that developer Taldren, best known for most of the Star Trek: Star Fleet Command titles, has closed. While there has yet to be an official announcement from the developer, further evidence has emerged: a Majesco spokesperson has confirmed that Black 9, Taldren's latest project, has been canceled.

Originally planned for the PC, Xbox, and PlayStation 2, Black 9 was a third-person action title set in a dystopic future. The game borrowed much of its atmosphere and some of its game play mechanics from titles like System Shock, and offered players a choice of different characters -- and the special abilities of each." - http://xbox.ign.com/articles/526/526761p1.html
